conversation_id.title: Channel ID
conversation_id.description: Channel ID (not the name). Use the ID Slack returns, never a #name.

transport.title: Interactivity transport (deprecated, ignored)
transport.description: IGNORED. Interactivity is a property of the DEPLOYMENT, not of one channel: it is OTO_SLACK_MODE plus a signing secret, and one process either has a Request URL or it does not. Socket Mode is not implemented at all. The field is still accepted so that configs written by earlier releases keep validating; it will be removed once no stored config carries it.
